The Verdant Scatter

Overview

The Verdant Scatter is the primary archipelago of the Shattered Sea, running east to west between the Galewall and the Drowned Maw. It is not one island chain so much as two arcs with a shipping road between them.

The northern arc is the Crown Islands: five larger, mountainous islands with deep harbours, forested highlands, fortifications, inspections, and the Dravosi Crown’s strongest regional foothold.

The southern arc is the Midchain: dozens of smaller islands packed close together, with free ports, reefs, local councils, pilot families, and routes that make more sense to people who learned them from grandparents than from charts.

Between them runs the Central Strait, the main navigable corridor through the region. To the east, both arcs narrow and converge at the Tail, where the water grows colder and the Maw starts shaping every decision.

People & Power

The northern arc carries the Dravosi Crown‘s strongest regional authority. The southern arc belongs more to island councils, free ports, pilot families, market bosses, Grung trade boundaries, and local arrangements that do not fit comfortably into a colonial ledger.

Trade & Resources

The Scatter moves inspected Crown cargo, free-port repair work, fish, shellfish, local market goods, Grung exports, salvage traffic, and contraband. Its economy depends on knowing when the official route is worth the price and when the local route is worth the risk.

Piracy Scale

The Scatter’s pirate threats scale with geography. The Knife’s Wake makes single bad channel choices expensive. The Bad Receipt turns Midchain paperwork into a weapon. The Glass Debt is what happens when piracy grows large enough that convoys, patrols, and councils all have to react.
